name: projects
description: The life of a project, kept in its README: /projects:new interviews for the finish line and first next action; /projects:adopt adds only what an existing project is missing; capture, board, review, close, pickup and mine keep the work moving from inbox to done. A session-start line says where the folder's project stands — outcome, done-when progress, next action — and, once a day elsewhere, what is waiting.
